messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] RStan error message after concluding sampling
parts:
You may have been running for so many iterations that
it wouldn't fit into memory when you were done.

Always start small and build out until you get R-hat near
1 and n_eff > 100 for all parameters (and lp__). The 2000
iteration default is probably too high.

- Bob

messages.author: 743bbacc59f4b25f
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] Re: RStan error message after concluding sampling
parts:
On Monday, October 10, 2016 at 11:23:22 PM UTC-4, Bob Carpenter wrote:
Is there a way to stream the draws to disk in RStan

There has been since before we moved to GitHub: Specify the sample_file argument to sampling() or stan()

An optional character string providing the name of a file. If specified the draws for all parameters and other saved quantities will be written to the file. If not provided, files are not created. When the folder specified is not writable, tempdir() is used. When there are multiple chains, an underscore and chain number are appended to the file name.

Ben

messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] Re: RStan error message after concluding sampling
parts:
Neat workaround---thanks.

- Bob

> On Oct 11, 2016, at 6:25 PM, Jiqiang Guo <guo...@gmail.com> wrote:
>
> Sort of. You can specify pars=character(0) when calling Stan.
>
> Jiqiang
>
> On Tuesday, October 11, 2016, Bob Carpenter <ca...@alias-i.com> wrote:
> I know it's possible to stream the draws, but what I was asking
> was whether it's possible to turn off saving them in memory.
>
> - Bob
>
> P.S. My own preference would be to fail if the user supplies a
> file path that can't be opened for writing, but maybe that's not
> how R normally works.
>
> > On Oct 10, 2016, at 11:58 PM, Ben Goodrich <goodri...@gmail.com> wrote:
> >
> > On Monday, October 10, 2016 at 11:23:22 PM UTC-4, Bob Carpenter wrote:
> > Is there a way to stream the draws to disk in RStan
> >
> > There has been since before we moved to GitHub: Specify the sample_file argument to sampling() or stan()
> >
> > An optional character string providing the name of a file. If specified the draws for all parameters and other saved quantities will be written to the file. If not provided, files are not created. When the folder specified is not writable, tempdir() is used. When there are multiple chains, an underscore and chain number are appended to the file name.
> >
> > Ben
> >
> >
